# Initialize pointers

increasing = []
decreasing = []

# Two-pointer technique
while left <= right:
    if left == right:
        increasing.append(a_sorted[left])
        break
    if a_sorted[left] < a_sorted[left + 1]:
        increasing.append(a_sorted[left])
        left += 1
    elif a_sorted[right] > a_sorted[right - 1]:
        decreasing.append(a_sorted[right])
        right -= 1
    else:
        # If neither condition is met, it's impossible to split
        print("NO")
        exit()

if len(increasing) + len(decreasing) != n:
    print("NO")
else:

    print(len(increasing))
    print(" ".join(map(str, increasing)))
